newsitem.title: USA: Resource America ups note offer to $100 mln.
newsitem.headline: Resource America ups note offer to $100 mln.

text.p: Resource America Inc said Sunday it raised its private offering of senior notes due 2004 to $100 million, from $75 million.
The offering is being made only to qualified institutional buyers and selected accredited investors, the company said.
It said proceeds will be used to repay about $21.4 million of debt, expand its real estate loan and equipment leasing operations and for other general corporate purposes.
It said it expects the offering to close by July 22.
